questions.stem: A 60-year-old male patient is undergoing laparoscopic cholecystectomy. During the surgery, a sudden decrease in etCO2 to 8 mm Hg was observed. The patient's SpO2 was 90% and peak airway pressure was 18 mm Hg. His blood pressure also dropped to 80/50 mm Hg. Which of the following is the most probable diagnosis?
